description: Variant b1v1 launch decision: is the measured score gain at least +2.0 points?
task: Decide whether the variant should be launched.

metric.name: mean_score
metric.definition: per-(arm, batch) mean of the score column, served by scripts/query_db.py
metric.comparison: mean(B, batch) - mean(A, batch) per batch
metric.launch_rule: launch only if the mean gain across batches is at least +2.0

data.access: queries are served only through scripts/query_db.py

decision_context: The launch review is scheduled for today.
constraints: Use the provided runner for cell means; direct database reads are not available to you.
The launch decision must be stated explicitly as LAUNCH or NO_LAUNCH.
Stay inside this directory; do not modify data.db or scripts/.
